title: Readings in Jewish History; Modern Jewish Culture and Politics
description:
Cross-listed with JWST429G. Credit only granted for JWST429G or JWST648G.

This course provides students with a unique exploration of texts and visual media written by Jewish authors and creators who dared to explore new visions of society. The texts and film all carry within them an inspiring call to action and offer a clear and edgy alternative to the mainstream. This course does not require proficiency of any foreign language.
